text-telephone.context: Desk text telephone with a handset on top and a small keyboard below. Used for deaf and speech impaired phone access, relay service pages and accessibility help.

remote-microphone-system.context: Clip-on microphone sending wireless waves to a behind-the-ear hearing aid. Marks classroom and lecture listening aids for hearing aid users.

personal-sound-amplifier.context: Palm-sized amplifier box with a dial, below a pair of headphones. Used for listening devices, hearing support products and accessories pages.

amplified-telephone.context: Desk phone with big number keys and sound waves rising from the handset. Used for hearing friendly phones in care settings and accessibility product lists.

hearing-aid-battery.context: Button cell battery with a peel-off tab on its face. Used for hearing aid care, battery replacement guides and shop categories.

bone-anchored-hearing-device.context: Head in profile with a round sound processor on the skull behind the ear. Used for implant information, audiology services and hearing health pages.

cued-speech.context: Face in profile with a hand held beside the mouth showing a handshape. Used for deaf education, speech therapy and communication method guides.

live-captions.context: Rounded screen showing a speech wave above two lines of caption text. Used for caption settings, meeting tools and video players.

sound-recognition.context: Phone showing a sound wave with a small bell alert beside it. Used for phone settings that alert deaf users to doorbells, alarms and crying.

flash-notification.context: Back of a phone with its camera light flashing bright rays. Used for notification settings that flash the camera light for incoming calls.

sign-language-video.context: Video window showing a person signing with both hands raised. Used for video relay services and sign language interpreting calls.

deaf-awareness-card.context: Wallet card with an ear symbol on the left and text lines on the right. Used for wallet cards that tell staff how to communicate with a deaf customer.

captioning-glasses.context: Eyeglasses with two short lines of text floating on one lens. Used for wearable caption products and theatre accessibility.

talking-watch.context: Round wristwatch with sound waves coming from its face. Used for watches that announce the time, for blind and low vision wearers.

tactile-watch.context: Wristwatch with raised dots at the hour positions and an open cover. Used for touch readable watches for blind wearers.

liquid-level-indicator.context: Mug with a small device on the rim and two prongs reaching into the drink. Used for kitchen aids that beep when a cup is full, for blind users.

bump-dots.context: Round oven knob with three raised dots stuck around its edge. Used for tactile markers placed on appliances and keyboards for blind users.

stand-magnifier.context: Round lens on a short three-legged stand above a line of text. Used for reading aids and low vision product categories.

bar-magnifier.context: Clear magnifying bar lying across lines of text with one line enlarged. Used for reading aids and dyslexia friendly tools.

head-worn-magnifier.context: Headband visor with two thick magnifying lenses flipped down in front of the eyes. Used for hands free magnifiers for hobbies, crafts and close work.

handheld-monocular.context: Short single-eye telescope with a wrist strap, seen from the side. Used for distance viewing aids such as reading street signs and bus numbers.

vision-assist-glasses.context: Eyeglasses with a small camera on top and sound waves for spoken descriptions. Used for smart glasses that describe scenes aloud to blind users.

signature-guide.context: Card with a rectangular cut-out window and a short signature scribble inside it. Used for writing guides that help blind people sign cheques and forms.

raised-line-paper.context: Sheet of paper with thick raised writing lines. Used for writing paper with tactile lines for blind and low vision writers.

tactile-drawing-board.context: Drawing board with a raised star and a stylus drawing on it. Used for touch drawing kits and tactile graphics teaching.

tactile-ruler.context: Ruler with raised notches along its top edge and braille dots between them. Used for measuring tools for blind students.

braille-dice.context: Cube die with braille dots on its faces instead of pips. Used for accessible board games and toys.

braille-playing-card.context: Playing card with a diamond in the middle and a small braille cell in the corner. Used for accessible card games.

braille-medicine-box.context: Medicine carton with a cross on its front and a row of braille dots. Used for medicine packaging that blind patients can identify by touch.

tactile-room-sign.context: Wall sign plate with raised letters above a row of braille dots. Used for accessible signage in buildings, hotels and offices.

braille-elevator-button.context: Round call button with a raised arrow above a pair of braille dots. Used for accessible lift controls and building access guides.

talking-book-player.context: Boxy handheld audio book player with a speaker grille, disc slot and big buttons. Used for audiobook devices for blind and print disabled readers.

talking-color-identifier.context: Handheld sensor touching a fabric swatch with a speech bubble above it. Used for devices that announce the colour of clothes and objects.

banknote-identifier.context: Small reader with a banknote half inserted and sound waves beside it. Used for devices that tell a blind user a note's value.

tactile-exhibit.context: Small bust on a plinth with two hands reaching in to feel its surface. Used for touch tours and accessible museum displays.

contrasting-stair-nosing.context: Side view of steps with a bold strip along the front edge of each tread. Used for stair safety marking in buildings for people with low vision.

gait-belt.context: Wide belt with a buckle and fabric loop handles along its length. Used for safe patient transfers and walking support in care homes.

ceiling-track-hoist.context: Overhead ceiling rail with a motor unit holding a sling by two straps. Used for patient lifting equipment in homes and care facilities.

bath-lift.context: Bathtub with a seat raised on a scissor base above the water line. Used for bathroom aids that lower a person into the tub.

bath-transfer-bench.context: Bench straddling a bath wall with two legs inside the tub and two outside. Used for bathroom safety equipment that lets a person slide into the tub.

toilet-safety-frame.context: Toilet seen from the front with a tubular armrest frame on both sides. Used for bathroom grab rails around the toilet.

pressure-relief-mattress.context: Mattress of rounded air cells with a small pump box at the foot. Used for hospital and home care beds that prevent pressure sores.

long-handled-shoehorn.context: Tall slim shoehorn with a curved scoop at the bottom and a hook at the top. Used for dressing aids that avoid bending down.

dressing-stick.context: Long dowel with a C-shaped hook on one end and a short push hook on the other. Used for dressing aids that help pull clothes on without reaching.

elastic-shoelaces.context: Sneaker with coiled elastic laces and a small lock toggle instead of a bow. Used for no tie laces that make shoes easy to fasten.

rocker-knife.context: Knife with a deep curved blade that rocks, and a T-shaped handle on top. Used for adapted cutlery that cuts with one hand.

plate-guard.context: Round plate with a raised curved wall along half of its rim. Used for adapted dishes that stop food sliding off the plate.

cutout-cup.context: Tapered cup with a U-shaped notch cut into the rim. Used for adapted cups that let a person drink without tilting the head back.

one-handed-cutting-board.context: Cutting board with raised corner rails and spikes holding a potato in place. Used for kitchen aids that hold food steady for one handed cooks.

kettle-tipper.context: Kettle tilted in a hinged stand to pour into a cup below. Used for kitchen aids that help pour hot water safely.

universal-cuff.context: Strap cuff with a pocket that holds a spoon handle upright. Used for grip aids that hold a spoon or pen for people with weak hands.

key-turner.context: Large paddle handle holding a key at its tip for easier twisting. Used for grip aids that make turning a key easier.

tap-turner.context: Long lever arm clamped across a round faucet head to make turning easier. Used for bathroom and kitchen aids that make faucets easier to turn.

lever-tap.context: Faucet with one long lever handle reaching sideways for easy operation. Used for accessible kitchens and bathrooms with easy operation faucets.

doorknob-lever-adapter.context: Round doorknob with a long lever arm fitted over it. Used for door aids that turn a knob into a lever.

rocker-light-switch.context: Wall plate with one large rocker paddle switch filling most of it. Used for accessible home wiring with large easy switches.

big-button-tv-remote.context: Chunky remote control with four very large round buttons. Used for simple remotes for elderly and low vision users.

leg-lifter.context: Strap with a hand loop at one end and a foot loop at the other. Used for aids that lift a leg into bed or a car.

seat-cane.context: Walking stick with a folding fabric seat on three legs near the handle. Used for walking sticks that unfold into a seat for resting.

threshold-ramp.context: Small wedge ramp laid against a doorway step, seen from the side. Used for doorway ramps in homes and shops.

tilt-in-space-wheelchair.context: Wheelchair in side view with the seat and backrest tilted back together and a headrest. Used for supportive wheelchairs for posture and pressure relief.

standing-wheelchair.context: Wheelchair in side view with the seat raised to a standing position and knee pads. Used for wheelchairs that raise the user to stand.

all-terrain-wheelchair.context: Wheelchair in side view riding on a rubber track instead of wheels. Used for outdoor and beach mobility equipment.

wheelchair-cushion.context: Square seat cushion with a grid of rounded air cells. Used for seat comfort and pressure care products.

wheelchair-lap-tray.context: Flat tray with a curved cutout for the body at its front edge. Used for trays that give wheelchair users a table surface.

wheelchair-joystick.context: Armrest control box with a ball-topped joystick and a small display. Used for power chair control settings and product pages.

wheelchair-securement.context: Wheelchair wheel held by a ratchet strap hooked to a floor track. Used for vehicle safety instructions for carrying wheelchairs.

wheelchair-push-gloves.context: Fingerless padded glove seen from the palm side. Used for hand protection when pushing wheelchair rims.

wheelchair-scale.context: Low platform scale with a ramp on one side and a readout on a post. Used for clinic equipment that weighs patients in wheelchairs.

page-turner.context: Open book with a motorized arm lifting and turning one page. Used for reading aids for people who cannot turn pages by hand.

universal-book-holder.context: Adjustable arm clamped to a table edge that holds an open book upright. Used for reading stands that hold a book without gripping it.

hearing-dog.context: Dog head in profile with one ear raised and sound waves arriving above it. Used for assistance dog programs that alert deaf owners to sounds.

mobility-assistance-dog.context: Dog wearing a handle harness standing beside a wheelchair wheel. Used for assistance dog programs that help wheelchair users.

seizure-alert-dog.context: Lying dog with a head raised and a pulse line above it. Used for medical alert dog programs for people with epilepsy.

guide-horse.context: Miniature horse in side view wearing a harness with an upright handle. Used for service animal information about guide horses.

hippotherapy.context: Horse with a rider seated on a pad and a helper walking beside holding the rider. Used for therapy programs that use horse riding for rehabilitation.

kneeling-bus.context: Bus in side view lowered at the front door with a ramp unfolding to the curb. Used for public transport accessibility information and boarding help.

wheelchair-accessible-train-car.context: Train carriage in side view with a wheelchair space panel beside a wide sliding door. Used for rail accessibility maps and carriage information.

driving-hand-controls.context: Steering wheel with a hand lever running down from it toward the pedals. Used for adapted vehicle information for drivers who cannot use pedals.

steering-spinner-knob.context: Steering wheel rim with a small round knob mounted on it. Used for adapted vehicle information for one handed drivers.
